note: Gateway actions and read sections that nothing in web/ names (#72, one layer up). Created 2026-09-17 after `stop_job` was found unpressed since the browser work — the action existed, the database function worked, and Grant could not stop a running job. `check:pressable` fails on a NEW entry and on a baseline entry that has become pressed, so this file may only shrink. Each entry below is one of three things: a missing control, something deliberately for an agent holding the bearer token (#13), or a reader the page genuinely does not need. The `why` map says which, and an entry with no reason is an admission rather than a decision. 2026-09-18: `section:studio` LEFT this file, and it should never have been in it. Its recorded reason said SUPERSEDED by the per-project reader the page actually calls. That was false — `web/studio/data.js` fetches it as the studio's primary payload — and the checker could not see it because `pressed()` matched a QUOTED name only, while the fetch builds `?section=studio` inside a template literal. A baseline entry with a false reason is worse than no entry: it is a documented excuse that stops the next person looking. The matcher now knows both forms and has a control that must match one of each.

why.action:revoke_tool: A SYNONYM, not a missing control. `app.revoke_tool` deletes the `staff_tools` row; so does the team page's tick box through `staff_tool_set`, which is the control Grant actually uses and the one his own approval confirmation points at. 0472 makes the checkbox the single writer and gives it the ledger event the request path always had, so the two cannot diverge. The gateway action stays for an agent-side or scripted revoke; a second button beside a working one would be furniture.
why.action:say: FOR AN AGENT. `app.say_in_project` is how something that is not a person puts a message into a project; the page has the composer, which is a different and better thing for a person.
why.action:grant_standing: FOR AN AGENT, and deliberately hard to reach: a standing authorization is granted by answering a blocker, where the offer states exactly what it grants (ADR-0018). A general button for it would be an approval detached from the thing approved.
why.action:set_google_secret: REACHED ANOTHER WAY. The Settings page posts the Google credential through its own form; this binding exists so the same value can be set without a browser.
why.section:staff: SUPERSEDED. The page reads `team`, which is the shape it renders; `hq_staff` is the older reader and CLAUDE.md records a verification that fed one to the other and passed for months.
why.section:artifacts: NOT NEEDED BY THE PAGE. Documents carry what the gallery shows.
why.section:bots: FOR AN OPERATOR. The Telegram bot roster is configuration, and the Channels tab shows the state that matters.
why.section:series: FOR AN OPERATOR. Time series behind the numbers the page already shows.
why.section:usage: FOR AN OPERATOR. `npm run measure` is the reader for this.
why.section:cost: FOR AN OPERATOR, same as usage.
why.section:ci_lately: MISSING READER, and the table is EMPTY. `public.ci_runs` holds 0 rows: every schedule and push trigger was removed on 2026-09-08 when 1,800 of 2,000 free minutes went to a five-minute cron, and only `workflow_dispatch` remains (#17). A panel for runs that do not happen is a found-nothing surface, which this repository has been caught building three times. Wire it if and when Actions come back on.
why.section:ci_budget: MISSING READER, same measurement. The monthly ceiling is enforced in the database and nothing has ever been dispatched against it, so the panel would read 0 of 1,500 for ever. It is also the one reading that is genuinely useful the MOMENT Actions return, so it goes back on with `ci_lately` and not before (#17).
why.section:relations: NOT NEEDED BY THE PAGE today. The project map draws its own edges; `relations_of` is the API answer to the same question.
why.action:browser_session_establish: MISSING CONTROL (#135), and blocked behind a credential rather than behind work: the Sources panel shows which sites the office is signed in to and offers no way to sign it in, because nothing can sign in until the Cloudflare account exists. Wire the control when the credential does.
